brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief focusing on high-yield developments across International Relations, Environment, Economy, and Science & Technology.

articles.title: India-ASEAN Maritime Security & Blue Economy Cooperation Framework
articles.summary: India and ASEAN member states finalized a new joint roadmap focusing on maritime domain awareness, sustainable ocean resource management, and anti-piracy operations.
prelims: Covers the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI) pillars related to maritime ecology and security.
Emphasizes compliance with UNCLOS (United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea) in the South China Sea.
Integrates the Information Fusion Centre – Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR) for real-time data sharing.
articles.mains: Examine how strategic alignment between India's SAGAR vision and ASEAN's Outlook on the Indo-Pacific (AOIP) can ensure regional stability and counter unilateral maritime assertions.

articles.title: RBI Releases Updated Regulatory Framework for Climate-Related Financial Risks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued mandatory disclosure guidelines for Scheduled Commercial Banks regarding climate risk exposure and green asset allocation.
prelims: Mandates Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) framework compliance.
Categorizes climate risks into Physical Risks (extreme weather events) and Transition Risks (policy/market shifts).
Requires banks to conduct climate scenario stress-testing starting FY2027.
articles.mains: Discuss the implications of integrating climate risk metrics into banking regulation on credit flow to carbon-intensive sectors in developing economies.

articles.title: Integrated Elephant-Tiger Corridor Conservation Policy Finalized
articles.summary: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change introduced a unified landscape-level conservation strategy linking Project Tiger and Project Elephant reserves.
prelims: Focuses on ecological connectivity to mitigate Human-Wildlife Conflict (HWC).
Utilizes M-STrIPES and AI-driven monitoring systems across transboundary wildlife corridors.
Recognizes community-managed eco-sensitive zones under the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers Act, 2006.
articles.mains: Critically analyze the role of landscape-level management over isolated protected areas in conserving India's megaherbivores and apex predators.

articles.title: National Quantum Mission Achieves Milestone in Superconducting Qubit Fabrication
articles.summary: Indian researchers under the National Quantum Mission successfully demonstrated an indigenously developed 8-qubit quantum processor using superconducting circuits.
prelims: National Quantum Mission (NQM) is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
Target: Developing intermediate-scale quantum computers (50–1000 physical qubits) within an 8-year timeline.
Focuses on four thematic hubs: Quantum Computing, Quantum Communication, Quantum Sensing, and Quantum Materials.
articles.mains: Evaluate India's preparedness in adopting quantum technology compared to global standards and discuss its applications in national security and drug discovery.

articles.title: Expansion of India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) to G77 Nations
articles.summary: India signed bilateral agreements with five developing nations to export its open-source tech stack, including UPI, Aadhaar-like identity frameworks, and DigiLocker.
prelims: India Stack consists of three layers: Identity (Aadhaar), Payments (UPI), and Data Management (Account Aggregator).
Supported by the Global DPI Repository initiative proposed during India's G20 Presidency.
Promotes soft power diplomacy through 'Tech Diplomacy' and South-South Cooperation.
articles.mains: How does the global deployment of Digital Public Infrastructure enhance India's soft power and advance Global South leadership?
